column1: # Franken Research movement census, 2026-09-24 (UTC). Read-only; GitHub API only.

# Census run 2026-09-24 02:53-02:57 UTC. Pins come from each packet's "Pinned commit" / "Pin" header line; matrix cells (ci_at_pin, rel_at_pin, license_at_pin) from synthesis/00-overview.md master matrix. Neither is edited.
# Commands (OWNER=Dicklesworthstone; REPO, PIN, HEAD, PIN_DATE substituted per row):
#   gh api graphql -f query=<Q> -F owner=$OWNER -F name=$REPO -F pin=$PIN -F pinwf=$PIN:.github/workflows -F pinlic=$PIN:LICENSE

#     Q = repository(owner,name){ nameWithOwner isArchived pushedAt defaultBranchRef{name target{...on Commit{oid committedDate}}} pinCommit:object(expression:$pin){...on Commit{oid committedDate}} headWf:object(expression:"HEAD:.github/workflows"){...on Tree{entries{name}}} pinWf:object(expression:$pinwf){...} headLic:object(expression:"HEAD:LICENSE"){...on Blob{text}} headLicMd:object(expression:"HEAD:LICENSE.md"){...} pinLic:object(expression:$pinlic){...} releases(first:30,orderBy:{field:CREATED_AT,direction:DESC}){nodes{tagName isDraft isPrerelease createdAt publishedAt tagCommit{oid committedDate}}} refs(refPrefix:"refs/tags/",first:30,orderBy:{field:TAG_COMMIT_DATE,direction:DESC}){nodes{name target{...on Commit{oid committedDate} ...on Tag{target{...on Commit{oid committedDate}}}}}} }

# Definitions: new_releases = GitHub Releases published after the pin commit date, plus tags whose commit is dated after it (tags checked with compare PIN...TAG = ahead). head/head_date = default-branch tip. workflows_now = files under .github/workflows at HEAD, compared with the same path at the pin (file presence only; C5 "disabled" states are not visible this way). license_now = first non-empty line of HEAD:LICENSE (or LICENSE.md). actions_runs_at_head = a snapshot of run conclusions/status for the HEAD sha at census time, not a pin verdict. authors_since_pin = commit author logins (or emails) dated after the pin; a date-window sample.

# material_change = [Inference, Medium]: "yes" only when census evidence could change a master-matrix cell (TRL, ring, CI class, release class, license, bus factor) at a re-pin. Commits alone never move a cell here; TRL and ring need a dated addendum. Result: 44 repos checked; 0 not found, renamed, or archived; 32 moved past the pin, 12 did not; 2 flagged yes.
